title.vi: Sắc lệnh sửa đổi Sắc lệnh Sáng chế năm 2020
title.th: คำสั่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมคำสั่งสิทธิบัตร พ.ศ. 2563

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-4-2020-E-PATENTS-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2020.pdf》（4 页），本次切分 14 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Patents (Amendment) Order, 2020 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 23rd April 2019.

Section 1 of the Patents Order, 2011, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended, in subsection (2), by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor.
Section 4 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (4), by deleting "the Minister, with the approval of".

Section 17 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (lo), in

(b), by deleting "Minister" and by substituting "Attorney General"

Section 53 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (3), in

(b), by deleting "Minister" from the last line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor.
Section 100 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (21, by deleting "Minister" and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor.

Section 105 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (31, in

(b), by deleting "Minister" and by substituting "Attorney General"

Section 107 of the principal Order is amended -

(a) in subsection (I), by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by (4, by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by

(b) substituting "Attorney General" therefor.
Section 108 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (21, by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor.
Section 112 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (I), by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor.
Section 113 of the principal Order is amended by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor.

The Schedule to the principal Order is amended, in paragraph 1, in the definition of "Chinese proprietary medicine", in paragraph (c), by deleting "Minister" from the last line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor. Made this 19th. day of Jamadilakhir, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 13th. day of February, 2020 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
